custody_model: Current first-party help material states users authorize CoinDCX to deploy supported assets on their behalf. Reviewed materials do not establish one universal legal-title, segregation or insolvency-priority model across current Earn and legacy DCX Lend.
yield_source: Current CoinDCX material describes multiple yield-generating sources including margin trading and staking. Published or displayed rates remain variable issuer terms and are not independently verified realized returns.
risk_notes: Current terms disclose minimum holding periods, possible no-earnings treatment on early exit, product-change or suspension discretion, and risk of partial or complete loss of deployed assets.
